set.descent_text: After the second pitch, mantel above the anchor onto the snow, which leads to the descent line. Walk off to the south over the snow, the same way as for the other routes on the west face.

set.descent_text: From the second anchor it is a short step to the top of the formation. Walk off to the south over the snow, the same way as the other west face routes. Rappelling this line is a poor idea because it is long, and snowmelt over the season lengthens it further.

review.notes: Route page: shared southward walk-off; rappel discouraged.

set.descent_text: Come down from the two-bolt anchor at the top, which carries a rap ring.

set.descent_text: Rappel the route rather than downclimbing the snow and crossing the bergschrund again at its foot. Long ropes make the descent easier.

set.descent_text: Descend by rappelling the line you climbed. Below the traverse the rappels go down the open face until you re-enter the large corner system.
From the top of the headwall, walk off by bushwhacking across to the neighbouring hill, then follow that hill's trails back down toward the canyon floor.
